markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (85%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Severe blur (severity 3) flags input reliability, leaves Normal unexcluded, and triggers recut and deeper-level orders.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 85%, Normal 15%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Favors benign; zero invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, Normal (90% target coverage, alpha 0.1) | Cannot separate Benign from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.35 (flagged) / 64th percentile (12/12 tiles) [F6] | Suspect input from severe blur |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 0/5 match Benign (all 5 Normal, 89–91% similarity) [F5] | Nearest neighbors all labeled Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.50 contribution, z=-0.82) pushes against invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.39 contribution, z=+0.83) pushes against invasion [F3] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 1, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.38 contribution) [F4], but concept is unreliable (0/20 spot check) · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Low score (+0.35 contribution, z=-1.53) mildly offsets benign push · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test cases (`risk_minus_random` +0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197 excludes 0, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (`concept_minus_random` CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable *Normal lobules* (0/20 AI spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- Severe blur (severity 3, reliability 0.35) masks diagnostic morphology on this simulated frozen section.
- Tissue is Normal rather than Benign, matching all 5 reference neighbors (including contrast case BACH_0236 at 91%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 6, 9**: Verify tubule formation and absent stromal invasion; region 3 has peak tile risk (0.029).
2. **Regions 1, 6, 8**: Inspect lobular epithelium (unreliable score in 1, 6) and region 8 for Benign vs Normal.
3. **Region 0**: Check medial margin (47% segment probability); review drafted recut/deeper-level orders and defer margin call [F7].
